Reliance Retail plans online expansion and earnings growth

Reliance Retail announced plans to significantly expand its online business and dark store network over the next three years. The company aims to strengthen its omni-channel capabilities and double its pre-tax earnings by fiscal year 2027. This expansion is part of a strategic roadmap focused on evaluating markets and directing investments accordingly.
